cursor.visibility: Only critical actual clicks,0.32s before/0.85s after; real OS telemetry

notes.animation: slide and fade; short underline reveal
notes.avoid: covering controls; flashing; fake PASS indicators; changing source UI

user_approval: Previous first chapter praised; preserve its style, wallpaper, narrow system-info panel, modern real taskbar and voice

semantic_emphasis.geometry: Read-only actual visible DOM ranges, physical native screen transform, occlusion checks
constraints: Short-lived marks; calm intervals between emphasis

numbers.policy: Write every spoken number in full Turkish words with its correct mathematical meaning and unit; distinguish versions and identifiers from decimals
numbers.integer_example: 1663506 → bir milyon altı yüz altmış üç bin beş yüz altı
numbers.version: 26.05 → yirmi altı nokta sıfır beş (sürüm bileşenleri; ondalık sayı değil)
numbers.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 → şa iki yüz elli altı
